result.question: What is the old prophet's answer to the man of God?

readings.answer: That he too was a prophet and that an angel, by the word of the LORD, told him to bring the man back to his house to eat bread and drink water.
readings.support: I too am a prophet like you, and an angel spoke to me by the word of the LORD, saying, ‘Bring him back with you to your house, so that he may eat bread and drink water.’”

assessments.reason: The reading accurately restates the old prophet’s reply that an angel told him, by the word of the LORD, to bring the man back to eat and drink; the passage also notes this was a lie, matching the key’s characterization.

result.reason: The text explicitly says the old prophet claimed an angel’s message to bring him back to eat and drink and that he was lying.
